variants.headline: Colony openly defies its charter
variants.sub: Open defiance of the charter is taking place in {colony}.
variants.body:
The colony is openly defying its charter. The defiance is established; a particular punishment or response is not. An assessment of {target} should distinguish the political and legal question posed by that stance from an invented account of what the home world has done in reply.

The colony is openly defying its charter. A big gesture, a serious question. But do not write the punishment into the story before it has been established. Readers can ask whether defiance is brave, reckless or justified without being sold a confrontation that belongs to somebody's imagination.

We defend {target} in this assessment. Compliance is not the only possible political virtue, and a fair hearing must allow a principled challenge to authority rather than treating defiance as self-proving guilt. Readers deserve a clear story and a straight answer about responsibility.
